Kristen Craft brings fresh fundraising strategy
to the Foundation Stage at TechCrunch All
Stage
Raising in 2025 doesn’t look anything like it did in 2021 — and that’s exactly the point.
At TechCrunch All Stage on July 15 at Boston’s SoWa Power Station, Kristen Craft, head of
Business Development at Fidelity Private Shares, will lead a roundtable session titled “It’s Not 2021
Anymore. Navigating the 2025 VC Landscape,” happening on the Foundation Stage.
In this conversation, Craft will guide founders through the new norms of venture capital. From shifting
investor expectations to sharper scrutiny on business models, she’ll explore what it takes to raise
successfully in a market that no longer rewards unchecked growth or vague roadmaps.
A founder-first lens on funding strategy
With deep startup roots and experience as both a founder and longtime operator, Craft brings a
uniquely empathetic perspective to today’s funding challenges. At Fidelity Private Shares, she works
directly with startups and investors on equity management, fundraising readiness, and go-to-market
strategy, giving her a front-row seat to the patterns shaping private capital today.
She’s also passionate about creating community and advocating for diverse founders. Her
background in B2B SaaS, combined with experience across strategic partnerships and digital
marketing, makes this session especially valuable for operators thinking about scale and
sustainability.
Whether you’re navigating your first raise or adapting your pitch for a more measured market, this
session offers a smart, grounded look at what it takes to succeed now.
It’s not just about adjusting your expectations. It’s about upgrading your strategy. Join
founders and investors at every stage at TC All Stage for this session and many more, led by scaling
experts. Register now to lock in launch prices and save up to $425.
